claims.text: Delgocitinib cream: topical JAK inhibitor for mod-severe chronic hand eczema in adults w inadequate response to topical corticosteroids, or when they are not advisable
claims.quote: is a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor indicated for the topical treatment of moderate to severe chronic hand eczema (CHE) in adults who have had an inadequate response to, or for whom topical corticosteroids are not advisable.
